name.message: Hide Upgrade Button for Gmail, Drive & Docs

description.message: Itinatago ang Upgrade at Ask Gemini sa Gmail, Google Drive, at Google Docs, pati ang Upgrade sa Google Calendar

popup_toggle_gemini_label.message: Itago ang button na Ask Gemini
popup_toggle_gemini_label.description: Label of the Ask Gemini toggle.

popup_calendar_access_label.description: Label of the optional Google Calendar access toggle.

popup_markup_note.message: Kung muling lumitaw ang isang button, binago ng Google ang interface — darating ang ayos sa update ng extension.
popup_markup_note.description: Popup note explaining that Google interface changes are fixed by extension updates.

popup_report_link.description: Popup link to the issue tracker.

popup_onboarding_link.description: Popup link that opens the onboarding page.

onboarding_title.message: Na-install na ang Hide Upgrade Button
onboarding_title.description: Onboarding page title and heading, shown after installation.

onboarding_intro.message: Nakatago na ngayon ang mga button na Upgrade at Ask Gemini. Narito ang mga dapat mong malaman.
onboarding_intro.description: Onboarding page lead paragraph under the title.

onboarding_how_heading.description: Onboarding section heading: what the extension does.

onboarding_how_text.message: Itinatago ng extension ang mga button na Upgrade at Ask Gemini sa header ng Gmail, Google Drive, at Google Docs, Sheets, at Slides. Umuusog ang mga katabing icon para punan ang puwang, at naa-update ang mga tab na bukas na nang hindi nire-reload.
onboarding_how_text.description: Onboarding: what is hidden and where.

onboarding_how_image_alt.message: Header ng Gmail bago at pagkatapos: wala na ang mga button na Upgrade at Ask Gemini
onboarding_how_image_alt.description: Alt text of the before/after illustration.

onboarding_calendar_heading.description: Onboarding section heading about optional Google Calendar support.

onboarding_calendar_text.message: Kaya ring itago ng extension ang button na Upgrade sa Google Calendar. Naka-off ito bilang default: i-on ito rito o sa popup, pagkatapos ay payagan ang access sa calendar.google.com kapag nagtanong ang browser.
onboarding_calendar_text.description: Onboarding: how to enable Google Calendar support.

onboarding_calendar_why.message: Bakit ito opsyonal? Hinihingi lang ang access sa Calendar sa mga taong nangangailangan nito. Kung gagawin itong required, idi-disable din ng browser ang extension para sa lahat ng may naka-install na nito hanggang aprubahan nila ang bagong access.
onboarding_calendar_why.description: Onboarding: why Google Calendar access is optional instead of on by default.

onboarding_calendar_enabled.description: Onboarding status shown when Google Calendar access is granted.

onboarding_calendar_disable.description: Onboarding button that removes Google Calendar access.

onboarding_pin_heading.description: Onboarding section heading about pinning the extension to the toolbar.

onboarding_pin_text.message: Nasa popup ng extension ang lahat ng setting. Hangga't hindi mo ito naipi-pin, nakatago ang popup sa likod ng Extensions icon na hugis puzzle piece sa toolbar: i-click ang icon na iyon at i-pin ang Hide Upgrade Button para isang click na lang ito.
onboarding_pin_text.description: Onboarding: how to pin the extension icon. Keep 'Hide Upgrade Button' untranslated.

onboarding_settings_heading.description: Onboarding section heading about the popup settings.

onboarding_settings_text.message: May sariling switch sa popup ang bawat button, kaya maibabalik mo ang alinman sa dalawa. Agad na nalalapat ang mga pagbabago sa mga bukas na tab, nang hindi nire-reload.

onboarding_returned_heading.description: Onboarding section heading about a hidden button reappearing.

onboarding_returned_text.message: Binago ng Google ang interface nito. Darating ang ayos sa update ng extension; kapag iniulat mo ito, mas mabilis itong darating.
onboarding_returned_text.description: Onboarding: a reappearing button means Google changed its interface.

onboarding_report_heading.description: Onboarding section heading about reporting problems.

onboarding_report_text.message: Magbukas ng issue sa GitHub at isama ang:
onboarding_report_text.description: Onboarding: lead-in to the list of details to attach to a report.

onboarding_report_item_service.message: ang serbisyo: Gmail, Drive, Docs o Calendar

onboarding_report_item_language.message: ang wika ng iyong Google interface

onboarding_report_link.description: Onboarding link to the issue tracker.

onboarding_privacy_text.message: Walang analytics at walang network request: nananatili sa iyong browser ang mga setting mo.

onboarding_privacy_link.description: Onboarding link to the privacy policy.

onboarding_rate_link.message: Nakatulong ba ito? I-rate ang extension sa store
onboarding_rate_link.description: Onboarding unobtrusive link to the extension's store page.
